item.title: SWE-agent
item.description: SWE-agent wraps an LLM in an “Agent-Computer Interface” — a constrained set of commands for viewing, searching, and editing files and running tests — so it can work through real GitHub issues end-to-end. It’s the reference agent behind much of the SWE-bench benchmark work.
